2607.06124.title: Static Metrics Are Insufficient: Predicting Java Method Energy Usage with Execution Time
2607.06124.paper_summary: The increasing energy demand of software systems is raising concerns about their environmental impact and associated costs. Reasoning on energy usage early in the development flow has the potential to significantly reduce the overall energy usage of a software system, as it allows developers to make informed design and refactoring decisions before inefficiencies propagate. However, assessing energy usage without repeated profiling and direct measurement is difficult, which limits early reasoning in practice. This study investigates the limits of method-level energy prediction in Java, examining whether static source code metrics complemented with method-level execution time can estimate the energy consumption of Java methods. We profile 2,786 Java methods to extract 33 static features and measure execution time and energy, then train and compare eleven regression models. Our findings show that static source code metrics alone yield poor predictive performance, with average R2 values close to zero. Incorporating execution time as a lightweight dynamic input significantly improves accuracy, raising R2 to as high as 0.46. Execution time, internal method calls, and cyclomatic complexity consistently emerge as the strongest predictors of energy consumption.
2607.06124.paper_summary_zh: 隨著軟體系統對能源需求的增加，人們對其環境影響和相關成本的擔憂也在上升。在開發流程早期對能源使用進行推理，有潛力顯著減少軟體系統的整體能源使用，因為這使開發人員能夠在低效能擴散之前做出明智的設計和重構決策。然而，在沒有重複剖析和直接測量的情況下評估能源使用是困難的，這限制了實際中的早期推理。本研究探討了在Java中方法級能源預測的限制，檢查靜態源代碼指標是否可以與方法級執行時間相輔相成，以估算Java方法的能源消耗。我們剖析了2,786個Java方法，以提取33個靜態特徵並測量執行時間和能源，然後訓練並比較了十一個回歸模型。我們的發現顯示，僅使用靜態源代碼指標的預測性能較差，平均R2值接近於零。將執行時間作為輕量級動態輸入納入考量顯著提高了準確性，R2值提高至高達0.46。執行時間、內部方法調用和圈複雜度始終被認為是能源消耗的最強預測因子。
